lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximate vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank, demonstrating a semi-regular 2D grid spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the lateral axis, forming a grid where circular blobs are localized at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the dorsal edge and a pronounced shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance circular blobs visible within the boundaries of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical banding and spot patterns are visible on the dorsal lobe of the caudal fin; presence of small teleost fish (remoras) attached or swimming near the ventral-pectoral region.
